Who am I?

Nice to meet you! I'm Simone Sgarro. I've been a graphic designer for a little over ten years now. Throughout the years, I've had the chance to look at design from many angles, and that's what led me to the kind of work I do today.

As a freelance designer, I help startups and small businesses grow by turning ideas into clear, effective visuals that actually make a difference. I'm into music and sports, but my portfolio is a mix of all sorts of projects — and that's what keeps things fun.
